learn.title: 1 · Problem
learn.md: Write a non-negative 32-bit integer in **English words**, for example 1,234,567 → "One Million Two Hundred Thirty Four Thousand Five Hundred Sixty Seven".

learn.title: 2 · Clarifications
learn.md:
- Format: capitalised words, single spaces, no "and"? (Yes.)
- Negative numbers? (Out of scope — reject.)
- Zero? ("Zero".)

learn.title: 3 · Key insight
learn.md: English groups digits in threes. Write one function for 1–999, then walk the number three digits at a time from the right, adding "Thousand", "Million" or "Billion" — and **skipping a chunk that is zero**, so 1,000,010 does not say "Thousand".

learn.title: 4 · Approach
learn.md: I would say, before coding: "O."ne helper for 1–999, applied to each three-digit chunk from the right with its scale word, skipping zero chunks — O(number of digits)."

learn.title: 11 · AI usage strategy
learn.md:
- Make the design decision yourself, then ask the assistant to attack it.
- Delegate the mechanical parts only after the structure is fixed.

**Prompts for this question:**

- *Check my design — no code* — "I believe one helper for 1–999, applied to each three-digit chunk from the right with its scale word, skipping zero chunks — O(number of digits). Review my reasoning without giving me the implementation. What would break it?"
- *Review, do not rewrite* — "Review my implementation for correctness and edge cases. Do not rewrite the code. List problems most severe first, each with the input that triggers it."
- *Race conditions* — "Now review this implementation for race conditions if multiple threads call Say concurrently. For each race, give the interleaving that breaks it. Then name the smallest synchronization boundary that preserves correctness. Do not write code yet."
- *Tests that expose bugs* — "Suggest tests that could expose bugs in my implementation: boundaries, duplicates, empty and invalid input, and concurrency where it applies. For each, say why the expected value is correct."
- *Complexity check* — "What is the time and space complexity of each public method as written? Do not claim a bound unless every step achieves it."

learn.title: 12 · Common AI mistakes
learn.md:
- Saying "Zero Thousand" or leaving double spaces for an empty chunk.
- Missing the teens (11–19 are their own words).
- Spelling: Forty, not Fourty.
- Forgetting 0 entirely.
